name: test_views.py
summary: Pytest-based integration test suite for Dataset REST API endpoints covering list, retrieve, upload, destroy, and schema operations.
purpose: Validates the behavior, permissions, and data integrity of Dataset views to ensure API contracts are maintained during development and refactoring.
responsibilities: Provide reusable pytest fixtures for test users, authenticated API client, and dataset instances
Test Dataset list endpoint functionality, filtering, and pagination
Test Dataset retrieve endpoint for fetching specific dataset details
Test Dataset upload endpoint handling file I/O and validation
Test Dataset destroy endpoint for deletion logic and access control
Test Dataset schema endpoint for metadata and structure validation
Verify authentication and authorization boundaries across all endpoints
Mock external dependencies to isolate view-layer behavior
inputs: HTTP requests to Dataset API endpoints
outputs: HTTP response assertions (status codes, headers, payload structure)
architecture_notes: Implements pytest-style integration testing over Django's native TestCase for conciseness and fixture support. Uses dependency injection via module-level fixtures to decouple test setup from assertions. Organizes test classes by API operation (List, Retrieve, Upload, Destroy, Schema) aligning with REST resource semantics. Applies unittest.mock.patch to isolate the view layer from external services. Co-located within the dataset app to enforce bounded-context testing and rapid feedback loops.
improvements: Migrate common fixtures (user, client, dataset) to a conftest.py for cross-module reuse and DRY compliance
Introduce factory_boy or model_baker for more expressive and maintainable test data generation
Extract shared authorization scenarios into a dedicated permission mixin or parametrized tests to reduce duplication
Consider splitting test classes into separate files (e.g., test_list.py, test_upload.py) as the suite scales
Replace unittest.mock.patch decorators with pytest-mock fixtures for consistency and better test readability
Add explicit negative-path and edge-case tests for large file uploads and malformed schema payloads
